correctnessFindings.assessment: Branch proof now folds complete streamed JSONL records into the existing incremental graph rather than splitting an entire readFile result. The file is opened once, sized with fstat, read through that initial prefix, and closed in finally.

splitTranscriptStreamLines defaults maxRecordBytes to Infinity at this exact head. This change therefore introduces no hidden record or whole-file quota; graph metadata and an individual oversized record can still be large.

Malformed unterminated tails remain retryable incomplete evidence. A missing expected prompt/marker after concurrent growth becomes a tail-incomplete result rather than chasing an indefinitely appending file. The 10000-ancestor safety bound is unchanged.

originalReview.userVisibleBeforeAfter: Stable transcripts yield the same branch proof with less whole-file retention. Concurrent appends are evaluated against one opened-file prefix; incomplete evidence follows the existing retryable path.
originalReview.capacityAndDataLoss: No new file or record limit. Streaming reduces transient whole-file ownership; graph metadata remains proportional to relevant nodes, and the line framer can retain a very large single record.

platformEvidence.assessment: Node descriptor ownership and bounded prefix reads are portable APIs. Fresh macOS tests include append/truncate/descriptor lifecycle controls; native Windows sharing and Linux filesystem races were not separately executed.
platformEvidence.executedHost: Fresh shared batch: macOS darwin arm64; Node 26.6.0. PRs outside that batch have no new execution in this follow-up.

originalReview.sshAndFolderCases: Proof stays with the existing file on the execution host. No SSH disconnection is treated as process exit. Paths and folder workspaces do not require Git-worktree identity.

regressionCoverage.description: The fresh batch includes claude-transcript-branch-streaming. Exact-head review checked the stream helper default and descriptor close behavior; historical artifacts cover allocation, duration, growth, parity, and descriptor reuse.

regressionCoverage.limitations: The memory improvement is not a constant-space proof. Growing files intentionally use a stable prefix and may require retry; no native all-platform race claim is made.
